source.title: fix(roadmap): build the trace facts from every plan run (#4267)

criteria: A unit test makes a toolbox client that records a `read_issue` call in its first run and no call in its second run, and a plan whose Feasibility says `read_issue` returned the issue. The first reply is refused for another reason, so the planner returns it once. The second reply passes the trace gate. Command: `uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_gates.py`. It fails today: the problem says that the run did not call `read_issue`.
A unit test records a `read_issue` call in a review run only. A plan that claims `read_issue` is still refused.
The golden set of the stage eval still passes. Command: `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay`.
